grandparents_cupboard.reason: Oats, flour, butter, ricotta, hazelnuts, honey, oranges and mint are all plain whole foods a grandparent would have kept.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, including ricotta and hazelnuts, is an everyday item at any mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: A bowl, small pan, lined tray and a glass used as a cutter are ordinary kit, and pressing out oatcakes is beginner-level.

works.reason: The oats, flour, butter and water ratio makes a pressable dough, and 20 minutes at 200°C crisps 5mm oatcakes, giving 12 topped oatcakes for a snack for four.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers mixing, pressing, cutting, peeling oranges and chopping nuts, and 30 cook minutes matches a 20-minute bake plus cooling.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the mint, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted apart from water appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Orange is in both the dough and the topping, so it is the point of a light spring afternoon snack.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Wholegrain oatcakes with ricotta, fresh fruit and nuts make a satisfying real-food snack with only a little honey.
